nina-partner: quick FYI — Saturn pilot customers expect usage cutoffs in CET local day. We accidentally normalized to UTC and it shifted a few hours.

marco-eng: can you share a sample?

nina-partner: sample: {"device":"gw-21","timestamp":"2026-05-10T00:15:00+02:00","units":12,"entitlement_id":"ent-900"} — shows up in previous UTC day.

liu-billing: contract defaults to UTC but partner requested local-day pilot. We need explicit opt-in.

marco-eng: propose a quick toggle: partner_window_mode=local for pilots. We'll rewindow last 48h when partner signs opt-in and mark rewindowed rows as non-invoiceable until review. ETA to enable toggle + backfill flow: 6h.

nina-partner: partner sent signed opt-in at 2026-05-10T06:12Z. Please proceed.

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1805 -> partner-local-day-optin (severity: low). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1805

marco-eng: toggle enabled, backfill started; audit flag `rewindowed` added to ledger rows.

liu-billing: backfill complete; invoices updated and customers notified per SLA.

nina-partner: thanks team — keeping marketing on track for the pilot launch. :thumbsup:
